thread:
Marie: FYI canary eu1 shows heatmap tile renders regressing, main-thread drawTiles spikes and a bunch of worker fallbacks in logs. LCP +1.7s :thinking:
Alex: thanks, any recent infra or bundle changes rolled to canary?
Marie: two small changes: a routing weight increase for prefetched chart tiles, and a telemetry client update that does an eager import on first paint.
Jordan: can you paste the error lines? even a few log lines help.
Marie: logs: "worker parse timeout, falling back to main thread (tileId=...)" repeated per tile ~100x in 10m.
Priya: that looks like either workers are saturated or parse time increased so they miss deadlines. Did bundle size change?
Theo: my telemetry patch added a codec helper for metric decoding, ~18KB minified, but it also pulls in a tiny polyfill. I didn't expect parse-time cost to be that bad.
Sam: routing weight bump would increase concurrent tiles routed to eu1 pods. If worker pool per pod is fixed, queue latency rises and cold parses can time out.
Alex: reproduce locally: run canary bundle + telemetry flag and simulate heavy tile load. Jordan, can you add a headless perf job?
Jordan: will add a puppeteer run to the canary pipeline capturing CPU profile and main-thread flame.
Marie: repro locally with --telemetry-eager: worker fallbacks spike. without it, workers are fine.
Priya: two vectors then: telemetry eager parse pressure and routing weight spreading more work to same pods. Both amplify each other.
Sam: short-term mitigation: revert telemetry eager import in canary and throttle routing weight back to baseline by 30% for 1h. I'll change the routing policy now.
Alex: also make worker fallback less chatty: log one warning per session per pod, not per tile. Flood logs are noisy and might worsen performance.
Theo: I'll open a small PR to lazy-load telemetry after firstInteractive and remove the polyfill.
Jordan: CI test: add a heatmap render perf stage that runs with telemetry-eager to catch this regression earlier. Tagging Priya & me to own it.
Priya: I'll write a short doc on routing weight semantics + how it affects worker pools so PMs know tradeoffs.
deploy-bot: routing policy rollback scheduled by Sam at 09:10 UTC (reason: heatmap regression).
Marie: post-rollback metrics: LCP back to baseline, worker fallback logs dropped to near-zero. Uploading traces: https://s3.redwood.internal/heatmap-repro/1746666666/flames
